CASCADE.gloss: rush down in big quantities, like a cascade
CASCADE.definition: Rush down in big quantities, like a cascade.

CASED.gloss: covered or protected with or as if with a case
CASED.definition: Covered or protected with or as if with a case.

CASE.example: It was a case of bad judgment.

SEA.gloss: a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land
SEA.definition: A division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land.

SAD.gloss: experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness
SAD.definition: Experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness.
SAD.example: Feeling sad because his dog had died.

SEC.definition: 1/60 of a minute; the basic unit of time adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites.

DEC.gloss: the angular distance of a celestial body north or to the south of the celestial equator
DEC.definition: (astronomy) the angular distance of a celestial body north or to the south of the celestial equator; expressed in degrees; used with right ascension to specify positions on the celestial sphere.

ACE.gloss: the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
ACE.definition: The smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number.
ACE.example: He has the one but will need a two and three to go with it.

DAS.gloss: any of several small ungulate mammals of Africa and Asia with rodent-like incisors and…
DAS.definition: Any of several small ungulate mammals of Africa and Asia with rodent-like incisors and feet with hooflike toes.

SAC.example: The trapped miners found a pocket of air.
